overview: Prospective cohort of all elective day-case laparoscopic cholecystectomies for 12 months from January 2027, with a nurse-led discharge readiness assessment at four hours and booking-time predictors recorded at the booking visit.
population: Adults booked for elective day-case laparoscopic cholecystectomy, about 620 in 12 months.
exposure: Predictors recorded at booking (age, anaesthetic risk class, body mass index, previous nausea with anaesthesia, living alone, travel distance, planned list position) and recovery variables from the readiness assessment.
procedures: Booking nurses record predictors on a standard form; a recovery nurse completes the readiness assessment at four hours; the outcome is taken from the discharge record.

outcomes.name: Failed same-day discharge
outcomes.measure: Overnight stay after a day-case booking
outcomes.why: The event the unit wants to predict.

outcomes.name: Form completion
outcomes.measure: Proportion of patients with complete booking and readiness forms
outcomes.why: Data completeness depends on nursing time.

feasibility: Depends on nursing time for the readiness assessment, which is not yet funded.

biasFlags.label: Missing assessments when the recovery nurse is unavailable

parsimony.simplestPath: One year of prospective data with standard forms.

summary: Prospective cohort protocol for the first decision.
